source_grounded_contract.capture_error: ScrapeView error card shows Reload page and Try again only for recoverable errors; restricted URL has no recovery actions and Dismiss remains. Deep mode first calls scrollToLoadLazy, then captureWithFallback. On no-receiver, captureWithFallback attempts to inject content-scripts/content.js and retries; therefore a stale tab after extension reload ordinarily self-recovers and is not a deterministic error-card stimulus. If an actual error is shown, Try again uses activeMode, then lastModeRef, then fast; lastModeRef is set before either capture mode.
source_grounded_contract.save: A successful save lands a Source and opens the optional filing panel. A refused/unreachable save remains in chrome.storage.local; the Unsaved card owns Retry for a held canonical URL and suppresses the competing ordinary Save. Queue is removed only after confirmed landing.
source_grounded_contract.recognition_role: T26 already specifies the guest no-lookup assertion. Preserve its guest applicability; do not remove or relabel that coverage. Signed-in recognition reads all RLS-visible organizations independent of selected org; explicitly selected organization remains the destination for writes.
source_grounded_contract.filing: FileSourcePanel appears only after landing; Close performs no attachment write. Library is a select including No Library; target chips are staged and removable; filing submits only when at least one target or Library is selected.
source_grounded_contract.organization: requireRequestOrganizationId delegates to holdForActiveOrganizationId. With no device selection it raises the picker and holds the save until selection; it does not immediately refuse. It errors immediately for zero memberships or after the person does not answer before timeout. Do not use no selection as a save-refusal fixture.
